meta.title: Embedded Engineer
meta.tagline: Program hardware systems that power the physical world.
meta.description: Embedded engineers develop software that runs on resource-constrained hardware — microcontrollers, SoCs and embedded processors. They work with real-time constraints, hardware interfaces and low-level programming.
